definition: For British Columbia measured beds, use the whole preserved package as a ceiling. Loosen original-to-preserved capture to at least one half in the three Idaho lake packages, two undated-width Washington beds, Redmountain, Pocket Lake and Pettit. Keep one Redfish core, RDF-4A. The facies cap is doubled for Redfish under the same response assumption.
scope: Independent full-data source-interpretation refit. This is not an independent geographic validation or a replacement for the principal fixed-prior study.
